title: Practice 2: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я сегодня ___ (забегать), но вас не было дома.
exercises.prompt: I stopped by today, but you weren't home.
exercises.why: «за-»: забегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: With you, it goes in one ear and out the other.
exercises.ru: У тебя в одно ухо ___, в другое вылетает.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: «при-»: прибежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Take the dog for a walk.
exercises.why: «вы-»: вывести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The ship sails for Honolulu tomorrow.
exercises.why: «от-»: отплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«пере-»: переносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
exercises.why: «об-»: оббегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«с-»: свести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You think Tom's handsome, don't you?
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«при-»: привозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We import grain from the United States.
exercises.why: «в-»: ввозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Следующий поезд «Синкансэн» ___ (отходить) ровно в девять часов.
exercises.prompt: The next Shinkansen train leaves at just nine o'clock.
exercises.why: «от-»: отходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: It hasn't come to that yet.
exercises.why: «до-»: дойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Rio's carnival is held in February.
exercises.why: «про-»: проходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сколько яиц в неделю ___ (сносить) эта курица?
exercises.prompt: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
exercises.why: «с-»: сносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The champion has successfully defended his title.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: When will Yuko come to Denver?
exercises.why: «при-»: приехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: «в-»: влететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«под-»: подвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«пере-»: перейти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
